text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A full blown-up picture of a bespectacled laughing Malawi President Bakili Muluzi covers the whole front page with a banner headline: Man of the year 1996.

- Malawi president Bakili Muluzi said on Wednesday that the country's young democracy should be nourished and jealously guarded by all Malawians. Muluzi said in his new year message that his government prefers working for national unity regardless of political differences for the good of the nation.
- A father and his son are hospitalised after sustaining wounds during a forced circumcision last Sunday following marital problem.

- Malawi Police are holding a senior official for Posts and Telecommunications on suspicion that he swindled more than one million Kwacha ($67,000) through illegal transactions by importing postal orders from South Africa.
